{{Quote|A port for trade, with little local product of their own except for the expeditions into the vast jungle.|Marda Ro, in her journal|<ref name="Closed Fist" />}}
A '''settlement''' on the [[planet]] [[Dantooine]] was the world's oldest [[City|settlement]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. It had a [[spaceport|port]] for trade and a [[Unidentified public house|public house]]. Around [[381 BBY]], the [[Evereni]] [[pirate]] leader [[Marda Ro]] visited the settlement during her [[Marda Ro's hunt|search]] for others of her [[species]] and questioned a [[Unidentified human (Marda Ro)|human]] familiar with the Evereni. She also recruited the [[Twi'lek]] [[Fori Nagor]] into her [[Nihil|band]] of pirates. Later, Ro talked about the settlement in a [[Marda Ro's journal|journal]] she recorded for her [[Ro family|descendants]]. Her [[Gender|great-great-grandson]] [[Marchion Ro]] had listened to the journal—including the entry mentioning the settlement—by [[252 BBY]].

==Description==
{{Quote|The settlement is ''[Dantooine's]'' oldest but remains small.|Marda Ro, in her journal|<ref name="Closed Fist" />}}
The [[City|settlement]] was located on<ref name="Closed Fist" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> [[planet]] [[Dantooine]] and beings of all kinds visited it. By that [[time]], it was the oldest settlement on the planet, but remained small despite its age. The settlement had a [[Unidentified public house|public house]] and a [[Spaceport|port]] for trade; however, its only exports were meat and rare animals obtained from a [[jungle]] nearby.<ref name="Closed Fist" />

==History==
{{Quote|The Twi’lek was not what I landed on Dantooine to hunt.|Marda Ro in her journal, regarding Fori Nagor|<ref name="Closed Fist" />}}
[[File:MardaRo-PathOfDeceit.png|thumb|right|190px|The Evereni Marda Ro (pictured) visited the settlement in search of other Evereni.]]
Around [[381 BBY]],<ref name="Date">"[[A Closed Fist Has No Claws]]" establishes that [[Marda Ro]] visited [[Dantooine]] around a [[Standard year|year]] after taking possession of the ''[[Gaze Electric]]'', an event that ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic Character Encyclopedia]]'' dates to [[382 BBY]]. Therefore, Ro's trip to Dantooine must have occurred around [[381 BBY]].</ref> [[Marda Ro]]—the [[Evereni]]<ref name="Closed Fist" /> founder of a [[Pirate|marauder]] group who would eventually become the [[Nihil]]<ref name="GrattonInterview">{{YouTube|video=llnvoEG0CjE|text=Interview with Tessa Gratton: "A Closed Fist Has No Claws" (TALES OF LIGHT & LIFE)|channel=@FriendsOfTheForce|name=[[Friends of the Force]]|date=2023-10-06}}</ref>—visited the settlement during<ref name="Closed Fist" /> her<ref name="Temptation">''[[The High Republic: Temptation of the Force]]''</ref> [[Marda Ro's hunt|hunt]] for others of her [[species]]. During her visit, she bought a nail file made from the [[bone]] of a creature known as an [[irisophant]] from a [[Unidentified child (Marda Ro)|child]] in a stall by a road. She also visited the settlement's public house, where a [[Unidentified human (Marda Ro)|human]] she questioned told her about a pair of Evereni he saw on a [[Unidentified space station (Pantora)|space station]] near<ref name="Closed Fist" /> the [[moon]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> [[Pantora]] around a [[Standard year|year]] earlier. When Ro left the public house, she was followed by the [[Twi'lek]] [[Fori Nagor]], who wanted to touch her. Ro confronted Nagor in an alley elsewhere in the settlement and offered Nagor a position in her band of pirates. Nagor accepted her offer in exchange for a kiss and Ro then took her to her [[Starship|ship]], the ''[[Gaze Electric]]''.<ref name="Closed Fist" />

Later, Ro recounted her visit to the settlement in a [[Marda Ro's journal|message]] she recorded for her [[Ro family|descendants]].<ref name="Closed Fist" /> By [[252 BBY]],<ref name="ShallaDate">"The Lie" chapter in [[The High Republic: Eye of the Storm 1|''The High Republic: Eye of the Storm'' 1]], which includes [[Shalla Ro]]'s [[death]], features [[Asgar Ro]]'s ascension to [[Eye of the Nihil]], an event dated to [[252 BBY]] by ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic Character Encyclopedia]]''. As ''[[The High Republic: Temptation of the Force]]'' establishes she introduced [[Marchion Ro]] to [[Marda Ro]]'s [[Marda Ro's journal|journal]], he must have listened to it by that [[Standard year|year]].</ref> during his youth, Ro's [[Gender|great-great-grandson]] [[Marchion Ro]] had listened to her journal, including the message where the settlement was mentioned.<ref name="Temptation" />

==Behind the scenes==
The settlement appeared in a flashback in the short story "[[A Closed Fist Has No Claws]]," written by [[Tessa Gratton]] and published in the [[2023]] young-adult anthology ''[[The High Republic: Tales of Light and Life]]'' as a part of the ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic]]'' multimedia project.<ref name="Closed Fist" />
